limitations: Only these two finite original appearance controls are in scope. Fade and experimental renderer remain Partial and receive no credit. No structural parents, aliases or other appearance/renderer/cache family gains completion credit.

Native whole-cell primitive opacity does not reproduce Qt precomposed-pixmap overlap blending. Old cumulative effective alpha approximates integer compositor rounding. Native grid architecture/layout is retained.

Background bitmap decoding uses existing native Image::load_from_path; unsupported formats/errors yield blank just as failed path admission cannot supply a pixmap. Path cache is main-incarnation owned rather than process-global.

Old Qt screenshot contains media in a different viewport; new Qt screenshot is a366x718background-only painter canvas. Compare31x17marker extent, bottom-right anchor and clear policy, not whole-window pixels.

Oversized native pink fixture intentionally fills the clipped viewport; nonuniform native marker is a stronger independent extent/resize input. Supplemental solid-marker images use real empty MainWindow owners, not replacement Qt windows.
Validation is Linux only; Windows and macOS are deferred. No parent, alias, fade, renderer or broader family completion credit is granted.
